$comment: Content-script budget from docs/tech-stack.md section 6 (D-08, raised to 18 KB by D-20). KB means 1024 bytes. Sizes are gzip level 9 of the built file. The toolbar (Preact) is bundled into the observer; the explanation card loads separately (Phase 5) with its own budget: it carries its own Preact copy, the card styles and the session logic, and must stay free of zod and React. Reader budgets (Phase 7): the reader page loads reader-page-js at start, reader-lazy-ui on the first selection/Explain, pdfjs-js on the first opened file, pdfjs-data files on demand. Hashed chunk names come from the bundler; patterns match by prefix. maxZipBytes (3.2 MB) caps the store ZIP and is enforced by scripts/audit-zip.mjs after `npm run zip`.

budgets.description: Always-loaded selection observer with the bundled Preact toolbar
Explanation card, injected on the first Explain (Phase 5, D-08); not part of the observer
PDF reader page JavaScript loaded at start (shell, React, selection controller, Listen); excludes PDF.js and the lazily loaded toolbar/card
Toolbar (Preact) and explanation card, loaded by the reader on the first selection and the first Explain
PDF.js core, viewer components and worker, loaded when the first PDF is opened
PDF.js runtime data (CMaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles, wasm decoders), fetched on demand; sum of per-file gzip
Reader stylesheet (PDF.js viewer CSS plus the shell)
